meta.searchConsole: NOT CONNECTED. ranking/impressions/clicks/ctr are null until a Search Console export is imported (see README.md section 4).
meta.volumePolicy: No search volumes are stated. demandSignal is qualitative: 'high' = many OTAs + operators + publishers compete and Google shows rich features; 'medium' = several specialist operators/blogs compete; 'low' = few dedicated pages, long-tail; 'unknown' = not checked. Each label is an inference from SERP observation on 2026-10-08, not measured data.
meta.competitionSignal: 'high' = OTAs/publishers with strong domains dominate page 1; 'medium' = mixed OTA + small operators; 'low' = mostly forums/aggregators/thin pages.
meta.priority: P0 = act in the next 30 days; P1 = next 90 days; P2 = later / after authority; P3 = monitor only or do not target.
meta.status: owned = an indexable HCC page targets it; draft-noindex = a page exists but is noindex; gap = no HCC page; hold = deliberately not targeted now; do-not-target = outside HCC's offer.
meta.sourceOfTruth: Prices, dates and schedules are NOT stored here. Always read them from src/content/trips and src/content/departures.
